subtitles.en: Here to help us break down those Lululemon results as Stacey Widlis. She is president and founder SW Retail Advisors. Stacey, Lululemon has so many things that it needs to fix right now.
subtitles.zh: 斯泰西·维德利茨是SW零售顾问公司的总裁兼创始人，她来帮我们分析Lululemon的业绩。斯泰西，Lululemon现在有很多问题需要解决。

subtitles.en: And it doesn't have a CEO yet, a new permanent CEO. She is incoming, Heidi O'Neill.
subtitles.zh: 而且他们还没有正式的首席执行官，新任CEO海迪·奥尼尔即将上任。

subtitles.en: Do we have any sense of what her plan has to entail here?
subtitles.zh: 我们能否了解她的计划必须包含哪些内容？
zh_highlights: 计划必须包含哪些内容

subtitles.en: Yeah, this has been, you know, two years of product mistakes. When we first started to see that and started seeing the markdowns in December 2024, we put a cell in the stock and recall
subtitles.zh: 是的，这已经是两年的产品失误了。当我们开始看到问题，并在2024年12月看到降价时，我们卖出了权益资产，记得两年前股价是500美元。

subtitles.en: the stock was $500, two years ago. So you're looking at a situation here where product has not been fixed. You're looking at a situation where the competition is skyrocketing with aloe and
subtitles.zh: 所以现在的情况是产品问题没有解决，竞争激烈，比如Alo和Vuori等品牌。

subtitles.en: vuary. You're looking at a situation where this brand is trying to be all things to all people.
subtitles.zh: 这个品牌试图满足所有人的需求。

subtitles.en: When you go in the stores now, you kind of look around and you feel like there's too much coming at you. It's not focused where the other brands are really focused. So those are some of the things
subtitles.zh: 现在走进门店，你会觉得信息过载，不够聚焦，而其他品牌则非常专注。

subtitles.en: going on. And again, we had a CEO announced months ago. We've been waiting and waiting and waiting.
subtitles.zh: 而且，CEO几个月前就宣布了，我们一直在等待。

subtitles.en: But the problem has gotten worse over the months. So we need to hit the ground running with a complete overhaul of a product here. And that's the main issue.
subtitles.zh: 但问题在几个月内承压了。所以我们需要立即行动，全面改革产品，这是主要问题。

subtitles.en: Yeah, and these things, what you're identifying sounds like it'll take months to fix at the very least. It's not going to be a turnaround immediately. The founder of Lululemon and key shareholder,
subtitles.zh: 是的，你指出的这些问题至少需要几个月才能解决，不会立即扭转。Lululemon的创始人和主要股东，
en_highlights: not going to be a turnaround immediately

subtitles.en: Chip Wilson has been an irritant as well for the company criticizing strategy from the sidelines.
subtitles.zh: 奇普·威尔逊对公司来说也是个麻烦，他一直在场外批评公司战略。

winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
